items.title: Fed’s preferred inflation gauge lands with a December rate increase already priced in
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 25, 2026

items.title: Ether, DeFi fall twice as hard as bitcoin as equities selloff resumes
items.summary: Bitcoin (BTC) is down 1.2% since midnight UTC as the stock selloff resumes, with ether (ETH) and DeFi tokens falling about twice as far.

items.title: Italy’s UniCredit launches six-year bitcoin certificate with gains capped at 65%
items.summary: UniCredit brings bitcoin investing to its roughly 8 million retail customers in Italy, offering them a six-year product that caps the redemption value but promises to return their capital.

items.title: Gold's haven status has lost its edge over bitcoin, and the Fed's to blame
items.summary: Gold has lost the risk-adjusted advantage that made it this year's haven of choice over bitcoin. Both now offer negative one-year Sharpe ratios, leaving cash yields hard to beat.

items.title: EU proposes $54.7 billion fund for AI, quantum startups alongside post-quantum security push
items.summary: Brussels wants tech firms to grow at home. EU scale-ups raise about half the capital of San Francisco peers by year 10, an EIB study found.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin tumbles under $58,000 alongside continuing tech rout
items.summary: Nvidia led a 4% plunge in the Nasdaq in early action Wednesday as inflation data remained troubling and the Trump administration was set to unveil a sweeping new tariff regime.

items.title: Solana developers move to stop validators finishing work on blocks that already lost
items.summary: The fix would stop the computers that run Solana from wasting effort on transactions the network has already thrown out, freeing up power its recent speed upgrade didn't touch.

items.title: Just 10 accounts drove all of the XRP Ledger's trading growth last quarter
items.summary: Data shows that the ten busiest accounts accounted for more than all of the exchange's quarterly growth, while trading by everyone else declined.

items.title: Crypto traders can now hedge Nvidia, Anthropic and oil bets on Derive
items.summary: Derive’s new options on Nvidia, Anthropic, stock indices and oil bring hedging tools to onchain RWA markets.

items.title: A year after buying bitcoin, Czech central bank won't say what it's worth
items.summary: The Czech National Bank bought bitcoin a year ago as an experiment. The coin has fallen at least 40% since, and the bank's audited accounts carry it at cost rather than market value. The CNB told CoinDesk an outside cust

items.title: Ex-FTX COO calls out Netflix over CZ’s ‘Asian mafia’ portrayal
items.summary: Constance Waing said Netflix used racist stereotypes in its portrayal of CZ and misrepresented life at FTX before the exchange’s collapse.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Ukraine passes bill to legalize crypto and tax profits at 23%
items.summary: Ukraine’s parliament passed a crypto regulation bill after three years of legislative work, with the new rules set to take effect in July 2027.

items.title: Japan’s SBI, SMFG launch Solana venture for stablecoins, tokenization
items.summary: SBI Solana Global plans to develop stablecoin payment infrastructure, explore AI agent micropayments and tokenize financial assets.

items.title: Hong Kong launches tokenized debt platform with 24-hour settlement
items.summary: The HKMA’s new platform supports settlement in multiple currencies and handles debt issuance, interest payments and repayment at maturity.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs near $5B in record monthly outflows amid AI stock rout
items.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs have recorded $4.94 billion in November net outflows, exceeding the previous monthly record of $4.51 billion set in June.

items.title: Bitcoin price may fall below $53K if bear-market history repeats
items.summary: Bitcoin price downside targets focused on the $53,200 realized price as research saw pointed to bear-market patterns continuing for BTC/USD.

items.title: HYPE drops 8% as Trump bump gives way to 40% slide from peak
items.summary: HYPE traded below its price before Trump’s August remarks as wallets linked to Abraxas Capital reportedly exited the Hyperliquid platform.

items.title: French Senate rejects 100K euro crypto wallet disclosure requirement
items.summary: Senators also rejected stablecoin-swap and crypto exit-tax proposals, while the 2027 budget remains under parliamentary consideration.

items.title: Stablecoin redemptions hit $12B in 30 days, echoing 2022 bear market
items.summary: Crypto research firm Kaiko said the cash-out was smaller than in 2022 and has slowed, with stablecoin supply down just 0.4% since Nov. 13.

items.title: Morning Minute: Ethereum Focuses on Security As AI Threats Rise
items.summary: The Ethereum Foundation pulls its quantum-resistance deadline forward to end 2028, as AI labs say their next models are too dangerous.

items.title: French Senate Rejects Plan to Make Crypto Holders Declare Self-Custody Wallets
items.summary: Holders had warned that reporting wallets worth over €100,000 could expose them to risk in a country hit by a wave of crypto kidnappings.

items.title: Florida Man Jailed for Using AI to Pose as Streamer N3ON in $260K Crypto Scam
items.summary: David Anthony Sanchez posed as the streamer to persuade a meme coin project's organizers to pay him for a fake endorsement deal.

items.title: Hyperliquid Leads Altcoin Losses as Bitcoin Slips Below $59K
items.summary: HYPE fell more than 8% after Abraxas Capital pulled out of Hyperliquid, while U.S. Bitcoin ETFs' November outflows passed $4.9 billion.

items.title: Take-Two Hits GTA 6 PC Port Leonida With DMCA, Taking Down 3,007 GitHub Repos
items.summary: Rockstar's parent said the project's "bring your own files" instruction was a misleading attempt to dodge responsibility for the leak.

items.title: OpenAI and Anthropic Insiders Fear Their Next AI Models Are Too Dangerous to Release
items.summary: Employees at both AI labs reportedly question whether their strongest models should ever reach the public, as researchers struggle to keep increasingly capable systems under control during training and testing.

items.title: Anthropic’s Claude Ship Lets AI Write, Review and Approve Its Own Code
items.summary: Anthropic’s new coding tools can review and repair software changes before approving them for release, leaving development teams to decide when a human still needs to check the AI’s work.

items.title: Coldcard Bitcoin Exploit, Revisited: How a Hidden Flaw Survived Years of Audits
items.summary: Coinkite’s postmortem reveals a software random-number generator shipped in place of the hardware one for over five years, slipping past at least 15 reviews.

items.title: Ethereum Foundation Says AI Is a More Urgent Threat Than Quantum Computing
items.summary: The Ethereum Foundation has doubled its protocol security team and is prioritizing a cryptographic overhaul as advances in AI threaten the mathematical assumptions that keep billions in crypto safe.

items.title: Bitcoin Losses Are the Worst Since FTX. Is the Bottom Near?
items.summary: Bitcoin slipped below $60,000 as realized losses nearly doubled in a week. Glassnode says the sell-off resembles past market bottoms, but another drop to $53,200 could be in the cards.
